description: Mirrors .github/dependabot.yml's scheduling, grouping and ignore rules, translated to Renovate's packageRules. See that file's comments for the reasoning behind each rule; kept here in `description` fields since plain JSON has no comments.

packageRules.description: Maven: setup/pom.xml is the only reactor. Weekly on Monday, matching dependabot.yml's schedule.
npm: the Angular app. Weekly on Monday, matching dependabot.yml's schedule.
GitHub Actions: monthly, matching dependabot.yml's schedule.
CDM versions are bumped deliberately as part of release coordination, not by a bot.
plexus-utils is pinned in setup/pom.xml to fix a specific CVE and shouldn't move independently of that.
jackson-bom is kept off minor/major bumps entirely - only patch updates are allowed through.
xtext-dev-bom is kept off minor/major bumps entirely - only patch updates are allowed through.
guava is kept off minor/major bumps entirely - only patch updates are allowed through.
Guice stays on major version 6 - minor/patch updates are fine.
One PR for routine Maven minor/patch drift, excluding jackson/xtext/guava (see rules above) so their occasional patch update still lands standalone; majors still come through individually.
One PR for routine npm minor/patch drift.
